test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Latika said to him, "I got a hefty discount on this television."

options.text: Latika told him that she has got a hefty discount on that television.
Latika told him that she is getting a hefty discount on that television.
Latika told him that she had got a hefty discount on that television.
Latika told him that she has got a hefty discount on this television.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Latika told him that she had got a hefty discount on that television.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in direct speech and we need to convert it to indirect speech.
 
• When we change a direct speech to an indirect speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reporting verb "said" changes to "**told**" in the indirect speech.
 
• The inverted commas ("...") are replaced with the conjunction 'that' to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The comma (,) is removed in the indirect speech.
 
• The first word of the indirect speech should be in capital letters.
 
• The pronoun "**I**" changes with respect to the reporter i.e. "**she**" and the auxiliary verb changes as per the tense.
 
 
• The tense of the given direct speech is **simple past tense **which will be changed into** past perfect tense.**
 
• **Direct**: “I did the work”, he said.
 
• **Indirect**: He said that he had done the work.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, option 3 is the correct answer.

 

Hence, indirect speech is - *Latika told him that she had got a hefty discount on that television.*
